caseName: Bank of America, N.A. v. Boykins
caseNameFull: BANK OF AMERICA, N.A. v. Betty Jean BOYKINS

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit. Petition for writ of cer-tiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit for further consideration in light of Bank of America, N.A. v. Caulkett, 575 U.S. -, 135 S.Ct. 1995, 192 L.E.2d 52 (2015).
